mapper.select: SELECT * FROM question WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT * FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (course_id, stem, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, points) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{stem}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{correctOption}, #{points})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET stem=#{stem}, option_a=#{optionA}, option_b=#{optionB}, option_c=#{optionC}, option_d=#{optionD}, correct_option=#{correctOption}, points=#{points}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE question SET deleted=TRUE, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND course_id=#{courseId} AND deleted=FALSE
